source_title: Solution-Processable ZnO Thin Film Memristive Device for Resistive Random Access Memory Application
notes: Bipolar switching; 100 switching cycles; retention >100 s without observable degradation; 300 us read/write pulses; ZnO film thickness 34 um; crystallite size 62 nm
state_count_notes: Paper explicitly reports two distinct and well-resolved resistance states: HRS and LRS.

source_title: Modeling and Simulation of Correlated Cycle-to-Cycle Variability in the Current-Voltage Hysteresis Loops of RRAM Devices
notes: 10 nm HfO2; device area 5x5 um2; experimental 100-cycle I-V data; sweep 0 to +1.3 to -1.3 to 0 V; forming near 3.5 V; HRS/LRS evaluated at -0.2 V; correlated cycle-to-cycle variability
state_count_notes: Paper analyzes HRS and LRS as two extreme conduction states, but does not report a fixed physical conductance-state count.

source_title: Stochastic switching of TiO2-based memristive devices with identical initial memory states
notes: 31 nm TiO2; active area 5x5 um2; initial resistance about 8 Mohm; unipolar switching; programming pulse 4 V for 10 us; read pulse 0.5 V for 1 us; stochastic switching between nominally identical cells
state_count_notes: Paper demonstrates stochastic switching between HRS and LRS but does not report a fixed physical conductance-state count; identical measured resistance can correspond to different filament distributions.

source_title: Resistance Switching Behavior of ZnO Thin Films for Random Access Memory Applications
notes: Unipolar switching; 100 nm ZnO; 150 nm Ti bottom electrode; 75 nm Ag top electrode; ON/OFF current ratio above 5; tested over 10 switching cycles
state_count_notes: Paper reports unipolar switching between two memory states, HRS/OFF and LRS/ON, corresponding to logic 0 and 1.

source_title: Physics-based compact modelling of the analog dynamics of HfOx resistive memories
notes: 5.5 nm HfO2; experimental analog and binary switching; TiN/Ti/HfO2/TiN; maximum resistance window slightly above 5; 300-pulse programming experiments; bipolar switching; experimental variability characterized
state_count_notes: Paper reports gradual multilevel analog resistance dynamics under weak pulse programming; no fixed conductance-state count is reported.

source_title: "Quantized conductance coincides with state instability and excess noise in tantalum oxide memristors"
notes: 10-18 nm TaOx; 100000 ON/OFF switching cycles; RON and ROFF derived from reported mean conductances GON=3.67e-2 S and GOFF=7.06e-5 S; quantized conductance states; strong excess noise near conductance quantum
state_count_notes: Device switches continuously; integer-multiple quantized conductance appears only in an intermediate regime and is unstable/noisy, so no fixed stable conductance-state count is assigned.

source_title: An electrical characterisation methodology for identifying the switching mechanism in TiO2 memristive stacks
notes: 24.1 nm amorphous TiO2-x; Ni top electrode; electroforming approximately 8-12 V
state_count_notes: Paper reports gradual interfacial resistive switching and multilevel behavior; no fixed conductance-state count is reported.

source_title: Multi-valued and Fuzzy Logic Realization using TaOx Memristive Devices
notes: Device area 2x2 um2; LRS 1.1 kohm; additional resistance states 6.5 kohm, 15.0 kohm, 53.1 kohm, 115.5 kohm and 3.2 Mohm; read voltage 0.1 V
state_count_notes: Paper reports LRS plus six multi-level resistive states, giving seven total physical resistive states for simulator state-count purposes.

source_title: An electrical characterisation methodology for identifying the switching mechanism in TiO2 memristive stacks
notes: 24.1 nm amorphous TiO2-x; Au top electrode; electroforming approximately 8-12 V
state_count_notes: Paper reports gradual interfacial resistive switching and multilevel behavior; no fixed conductance-state count is reported.

source_title: An electrical characterisation methodology for identifying the switching mechanism in TiO2 memristive stacks
notes: 24.1 nm amorphous TiO2-x; Pt top electrode; electroforming approximately 8-12 V
state_count_notes: Paper reports gradual interfacial resistive switching and multilevel behavior; no fixed conductance-state count is reported.

source_title: Resistive Switching in Microscale Anodic Titanium Dioxide-Based Memristors
notes: S2 thickest anodic TiO2 sample approximately 29 nm; experimentally reported ROFF/RON ratio 80; gradual analog bipolar switching; for 10x10 um2 S2 devices VSET approximately -2 V and VRESET approximately +2 V
state_count_notes: Paper reports gradual bipolar switching typical of an analog memristor and multiple resistance states, but no fixed conductance-state count.
